iconicAnchor.label: Night Vision: Photography After Dark
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Met notes that fog and rising mist reflect and diffuse available light, producing distinct nocturnal atmosphere.

sources.title: Night Vision: Photography After Dark
supports: Fog and wet surfaces reflect and diffuse light, changing both exposure and nocturnal mood.

sources.title: Boden Sea, Uttwil
supports: Luminous haze, shredding mist, and horizon structure demonstrate how atmospheric variation can create perceptual depth with minimal subject matter.
